title: Metis: Typed Runtime Mediation for Tool-Using Software Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.25322v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software agents connect probabilistic model output to operations that change repositories, processes, networks, and graphical applications. We present Metis, a multi-provider runtime that converts provider streams into typed events before admitted calls reach external effects. Its execution path makes permission decisions, interference classes, terminal results, and lifecycle transitions explicit and inspectable. We evaluate these mechanisms on frozen source artifacts. Across 30 matched real-I/O pairs, four-class mediation reduced median elapsed time from 25.958 ms under forced serialization to 14.146 ms. The mean paired difference was -12.295 ms (95% bootstrap interval [-12.968, -11.694]), with mediation faster in all pairs. A ten-case fault matrix exposed duplicate-identifier and rollback limits. In a child-boundary ablation, the full gate-plus-registry condition blocked the declared unauthorized effect and hid all five escape tools. R

translated_title: Metis：面向工具使用软件代理的类型化运行时中介
translated_abstract: 软件代理将概率模型的输出连接到改变仓库、流程、网络和图形应用的操作中。我们提出了Metis，一个多提供者运行时，它在被允许的调用到达外部效果之前，将提供者流转换为类型化事件。其执行路径使权限决策、干扰类别、终端结果和生命周期转换变得明确且可检查。我们在冻结的源代码工件上评估了这些机制。在30对匹配的真实I/O对中，四类中介将中位耗时从强制序列化下的25.958毫秒降至14.146毫秒。平均配对差异为-12.295毫秒（95%自举区间[-12.968, -11.694]），所有配对中中介均更快。一个十案例故障矩阵暴露了重复标识符和回滚限制。在子边界消融中，完整的门控加注册表条件阻止了声明未经授权的效果，并隐藏了所有五个逃逸工具。
tldr: 本文提出Metis，一种通过类型化事件流实现显式权限决策和干扰分类的运行时中介机制，显著降低了工具使用代理的延迟并增强了安全性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Metis, a runtime mediation mechanism that converts provider streams into typed events for explicit permission decisions and interference classification, significantly reducing latency and enhancing security for tool-using agents.
